links.outcome: Proportion of respondents reporting existing institutional AI policies
links.effect: Only 7.4% reported existing institutional AI policies, despite 78.3% professional use of generative AI.
links.quote: Institutional AI governance was nearly absent, with only 7.4% reporting existing policies.

links.outcome: Availability of structured AI training and interest in formal training
links.effect: 88.4% expressed interest in formal AI training; adoption occurred almost entirely without structured training.
links.quote: Despite this, 88.4% expressed interest in formal AI training and 65.6% supported integration into clinical guidelines.

screen.reason: Survey of real-world adoption, use patterns, perceived value, risks, and governance of generative AI among Latin American emergency clinicians.
